translationRepairs: At the beginning of Tongzhi, on recommendation of Chinese and foreign ministers, he was appointed intendant of the Kai-Gui-Chen-Xu circuit in Henan, served as provincial treasurer, and was promoted to Governor-General of the Eastern Rivers.

At the beginning of Tongzhi, on recommendation of capital and provincial ministers, he was appointed intendant of the Kai-Gui-Chen-Xu circuit in Henan, served as provincial treasurer, and was promoted to Governor-General of the Eastern Rivers.
s0168 has 以中外大臣薦. In Qing official usage 中外大臣 means capital and provincial high officials, not Chinese and foreign ministers; the proposed wording corrects that mistranslation.
After mourning for his parents he was appointed vice minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.
After a period of mourning he was appointed vice minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.

s0080 says 遭憂歸，服闋, which marks entry into mourning and its completion but does not name both parents; idiomatic 'mourning for his parents' invents that detail, and the proposed wording removes it without adding new error.
After mourning for his parents he was made supervising secretary.
After a period of mourning he was made supervising secretary.
s0152 says 遭憂去官，服闋, likewise without specifying both parents; removing invented 'parents' restores fidelity while keeping a natural idiomatic appointment clause.
